# Neuromorphic_Selective_State_Space

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A hybrid architecture that integrates selective state-space models (like Mamba) with spiking neural network dynamics, using event-driven gating to control information flow. Bridges sequence modeling and neuromorphic computing, enabling efficient temporal reasoning in both TCC and iNEST systems.
